what: New pre-launch result-envelope helper is not required to preserve the existing symlink-refusing result-env write contract
scenario_or_breakage: If .step3-review-result.env is a symlink or otherwise untrusted, a naive overwrite in the new helper can follow the symlink and corrupt data outside the session while bypassing the wrapper's existing symlink refusal path
suggested_fix: Revise the plan to require a symlink-safe atomic writer for the helper, preferably phase_driver_write_result_env or an equivalent explicit symlink refusal, with stdout KV fallback still emitted on write refusal
